scientific_integrity: The periodic-boundary twist criterion and the exact open-boundary AKLT and Majumdar-Ghosh calculations are prior work. The new claim is restricted to the stated primitive symmetric-MPS class and is proved by transfer-matrix perturbation. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to primitive finite-bond-dimension SU(2)-covariant MPS tensors with fixed open boundaries and a nonzero leading norm-transfer coefficient.
The estimate is O(L^{-1}) with a tensor- and boundary-dependent constant; no universal coefficient is derived.
No conclusion is established for arbitrary gapped open-chain ground states, nonprimitive transfer matrices, or reduced-symmetry models.
title: Open-boundary twist convergence for primitive SU(2)-symmetric matrix product states
